text:
Rewrite the opening of the study page's 'Start here' section so a first-time reader gets a plain overview before any exit codes, locks or protocol terms. Move details such as exit codes and 'guarded fast-forward' further down, or define each one where it first appears. Also move the 'Limits of this study' note above the glossary. Add a rendered-page test that checks both: the first paragraph of 'Start here' contains none of those terms, and the limits note comes before the glossary.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Audience raters keep saying the study page's 'Start here' section is too dense and full of jargon for a newcomer (35 rating records mention it)
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
